mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notifications (user_id, type, title, content, related_type, related_id, is_read, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{title}, #{content}, #{relatedType}, #{relatedId}, 0, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE user_notifications SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE user_notifications SET is_read = 1, read_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM user_notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM user_notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0 ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_notifications WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
